pages.c36-p01: Define VR, AR, mixed reality and XR and give examples of each
pages.c36-p02: Explain how XR headsets use displays, lenses, tracking and low latency to create presence, and why motion sickness happens
pages.c36-p03: Explain how AR apps detect and map the real world, and describe uses of AR
pages.c36-p04: Describe how XR is used in training, healthcare, education and industry, and evaluate its benefits and limitations
pages.c36-p05: Describe the health, safety, privacy and ethical issues of XR and how to use it responsibly
pages.c36-p06: Design a comfortable, accessible and purposeful XR experience using user-centred design and storyboarding

o: Digital objects interact with the real world
